latest_release.name: TizenTube Standalone v2.1.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* The TizenTube Cobalt for Samsung TV app being slow was fixed.
* Added a new build option for those who can't get TizenTube Cobalt working due to unkown problems. Read the [installation guide](https://github.com/reisxd/TizenTube/blob/main/docs/README.md) for more information.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/reisxd/TizenTube/compare/v2.1.0...v2.1.1
